findings.message: Permission mode changed from 0750 to 0700 prevents the _daemon_ user (UID 584792) from accessing /opt/demo directory. The service runs as _daemon_ and must read /opt/demo/server.conf at startup with no fallback.
Ownership changed from 584792:584792 (daemon user) to 0:0 (root). Combined with mode 0700, the daemon service can no longer access /opt/demo at runtime.

summary: Source commit bump modifies runtime-config part in rockcraft.yaml. Proposed changes alter /opt/demo from 584792:584792 0750 to 0:0 0700, removing execute permission and changing ownership from service user to root, breaking service access to mandatory configuration file.
